# polygons.types: PolygonWithHoles2D

**Status:** Supported (tier `geometry`). In a shipping tier; the lint, type-check, and code-generation gates cover it. No release promises its signature yet.

## Summary

> A polygonal region with holes: the area inside Boundary and outside every
> hole. Invariants: holes lie strictly inside the boundary, are mutually
> disjoint, and wind opposite to it.
> (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Polygon\_with\_holes)
